definitions.explanation: a mechanical or structural arrangement designed to achieve a specific effect
a clever plan or arrangement designed to produce a desired outcome

notes:
{仕掛|しか}け refers to mechanisms, devices, or clever setups.

ETYMOLOGY:
- From {仕掛|しか}ける (to set up, to set a trap)
- {仕|し}: To do
- {掛|か}け: To hang, to set

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1: Physical mechanisms (clocks, toys, traps)
- Sense 2: Abstract tricks or setups (plots, magic tricks)

COMPOUNDS:
- {仕掛|しか}け⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧ (pop-up book)
- {仕掛|しか}け⟦{花火|はなび}→花火：00087_hanabi⟧ (fireworks display)
- {仕掛|しか}け{時計|どけい} (mechanical clock with figures)
- からくり{仕掛|しか}け (elaborate mechanism)

- {仕掛|しか}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a mechanism/trick)
- {仕掛|しか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to create a mechanism)
- {仕掛|しか}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見破|みやぶ}る→見破る：18726_miyaburu⟧ (to see through a trick)
